response.justification: Bogdan demonstrates extensive fullstack development experience across multiple domains, with strong TypeScript, React, and Node.js expertise required for this role. His background includes scalable systems, cloud infrastructure (AWS), and clean architecture practices. While his experience leans more toward senior roles, his pragmatic approach and adaptability suggest he could thrive in a junior/mid-level capacity with mentorship.
strengths: Over 10 years of fullstack development with strong TypeScript/Node.js and React experience
Proven track record in scalable systems, cloud infrastructure (AWS), and clean architecture
Demonstrated ability to learn new technologies quickly and mentor others (e.g., workshops, open-source contributions)
concerns: Current role (re:cinq) appears to be at a higher seniority level than this position requires
Limited direct experience with PostgreSQL (uses MongoDB primarily) and nested.js
May be overqualified for a junior/mid-level role, potentially leading to engagement or retention challenges
